acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We repair prep fridges, under-bench units, upright freezers, display fridges, coolrooms and ice machines for restaurants and cafes in Harris Park. Commercial call-outs are about $100 to $250, and commercial repairs usually cost $200 to $900.

mainEntity.name: My restaurant fridge failed during service. What should I do?

acceptedAnswer.text: Close the doors and leave them, put the riskiest food in a working fridge or a cooler with ice, and measure the temperature with a probe. Cold food needs to stay at 5°C or below. Then send us the equipment details and what it is doing.
